label: Run Filter Hook
description: Runs a ThunderPHP filter and renders its returned value at this position in the View.

properties.name: hook_name
properties.label: Hook name
properties.help: The public filter hook name registered by other plugins with add_filter().

properties.name: escape_output
properties.label: Escape filtered output
properties.help: Enable for plain text. Leave disabled when the filter intentionally returns trusted HTML.

properties.name: component_name
properties.label: Reusable component name
properties.help: Leave blank to render at this node's position. Set a name while the node is a View root to place it with <tvi-component name="..." />.
